sections.heading: Lupin's Mandideep Unit-2 and Its US FDA Inspection
paragraphs: Lupin announced that its Unit-2 manufacturing facility at Mandideep completed a US FDA good manufacturing practice inspection, held from 7 to 11 August 2023, with no observations.

Indian Pharma Post later reported that Lupin had received the Establishment Inspection Report for Mandideep Unit-2, noting that the site had faced regulatory challenges since November 2022 and that management had been addressing US FDA warning letters. Managing director Nilesh Gupta was quoted on the result.

sections.heading: A Mumbai-Headquartered Drug Maker at Mandideep
paragraphs: Medical Dialogues describes Lupin as headquartered in Mumbai and selling branded and generic formulations, biotech products and active pharmaceutical ingredients in more than 100 markets, which makes Mandideep part of a supply chain answerable to several regulators at once.

For a plant that has worked through warning letters and then cleared an inspection, documentation on every process-contact length matters as much as the steel itself, and that is the paperwork our electropolished tube is supplied with. Lupin's release lists 15 manufacturing sites, 7 research centres and more than 20,000 professionals across the group. When an auditor walks a process line, each electropolished length we supply can be matched to its heat number through the EN 10204 3.1 certificate, and its surface to the Ra report for that lot, so the tube's records sit alongside the plant's own qualification documents.

sections.heading: Matching Tube Finish to Mandideep Product Lines
paragraphs: Purified water distribution, process transfer between vessels and clean-in-place supply in an API or formulation block are the runs where a smooth, passivated bore limits residue and microbial hold-up, so we recommend 316L to ASTM A270 with an SF4 electropolished finish per ASME BPE there. Every electropolished lot carries an Ra report plus an EN 10204 3.1 certificate tracing the tube to its heat number.

Cooling water, chilled water, compressed air and general utility headers seldom need an electropolished bore, and 304L to ASTM A269 or A312 in SF1 or mill finish is normally the economical choice for that pipework. A drawing that marks which loops are product-contact and which are utility lets us price the two grades separately in a single quotation.

sections.heading: What to Send With a Mandideep Enquiry
bullets: Section the tube is for: purified water, process transfer, CIP supply or utilities
Tube sizes as outside diameter by wall, plus the length in metres for each
Material and surface for each system: 316L SF4 for product contact, 304L SF1 or mill finish for utilities
The specification your validation file cites (ASTM A270, A269 or ASME BPE) and the Ra limit
Clamp ferrules, sanitary bends, tees and reducers that should be quoted with the tubing

sections.heading: Delivery to Mandideep, Bhopal and Central Madhya Pradesh
paragraphs: Tube for Mandideep is sent by road from Mumbai with every electropolished length end-capped and sleeved against contamination, and the dispatch date and transit period appear in writing on the order confirmation. Lengths are PMI-tested before they are loaded, and a fully specified enquiry gets a quotation back within 24 hours.
